title: 100 MTG Basic Land Cards Lot, 20 of Each - Magic the Gathering
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Mixed Card Lots
descriptionText:
The product is a lot of 100 Magic: The Gathering Basic Land cards, with 20 of each type included. The cards are manufactured by Wizards of the Coast and have a regular finish. It falls under the category of CCG Mixed Card Lots and is suitable for collectors and players of the popular trading card game. 

Swamp, plains, mountain, forest, and island
